༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'bri gung pa la phyag 'tshal lo| |mdo sngags thun mong du gyur pa'i lam zab mo 'di bla ma mtshan ldan gyis slob ma snod ldan la ston pa'i tshe spyi don gsum/ sngon du 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong min pa dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po ni/ slob ma'i lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam ste/ dal ba brgyad/ rang 'byor lnga/ gzhan 'byor lnga ste bcu rnams ngos bzung*/ de nyid dpe dang*/ rgyu dang*/ grangs dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ tshe skad cig mar mi sdod pa/ thabs gang gis kyang mi stongs pa/ tshe la nges pa med pa/ 'chi rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen nyung ba sogs kyi sgo nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam| gsum pa ni/ bral 'bras/ rnam smin/ rgyu mthun/ dbang gi 'bras bu dang bzhi/ rgyu mthun la/ byed pa dang myong ba gnyis/ las la/ mi g.yo ba'i las/ myong 'gyur/ ma nges pa sogs kyi rgyu 'bras bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ tsha dmyal la/ yang sos/ thig nag /tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba| ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ bsdus 'joms/ mnar med dang brgyad/ de'i 'khor me mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ ral gri'i lo ma'i nags/ shal ma li'i sdong po/ thal tshan gyi chu bo rnams so// grang dmyal la/ chu bur can/ de'i rdol pa can/ a chu zer ba/ kyi hud zer ba/ so tham tham pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ ut+pal ltar cher gas pa rnams so// gzhan yang*/ nyi tshe ba dang nye 'khor ba sogs so// yi dwags la/ phyi nang*/ zas skom/ spyi mthun gyi sgrib pa can rnams so// dud 'gro la/ byings na gnas pa dang kha 'thor ba rnams so// mi la/ skye rga na 'chi sogs so// lha min la/ 'thab rtsod sogs so// lha rnams la/ lus kha dog 'gyur ba/ stan la mi dga' ba/

rgyan phreng nyams pa/ gos la dri ma chags pa/ lus la rngul 'byung ba sogs 'chi 'pho sbron byed lnga'o// de sogs 'khor ba'i nyes pa bsam pa'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dang po rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa skyabs 'gro'i khrid la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig /dbye ba/ bslab bya/ nyams len/ mdun mkhar khri'i steng dbus su rdo rje 'chang*/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas stong*/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du byang sems dge 'dun/ smad skor du chos srung rnams gsal btab/ mchod bstod/ skyabs 'gro bdag gzhan 'gro tshogs mnyam du bya bar bsam/ bdag gis dngos su bya/ skyabs yul rang la bstim/ gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag byed rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa ni/ spyi bor pad zla'i steng du gsung*/ thugs las sku bskyed/ gnas gsum rgyas btab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ rgyas btab/ mchod bstod/ thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dang sngags phreng gsal btab/ yig brgya bgrang*/ spro bsdu dang rgyun 'bab bya/ gsol ba btab/ rang la bsdu/ gsum pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal tshad ldan gyi steng du lnga tshom rgyu dag pas bkod/ skyabs yul ltar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gsal btab/ de la mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma'am bdun pa sogs dbul/ gsol ba btab/ tshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ bzhi pa rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ mdun du khri'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma dang sbyor ba brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor bar bskyed/ mchod bstod/ rigs kun mas gsol ba btab/ mos gus bskyed/ brgyud rim rnams gtso bor thim/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing ser/ bdag gi dpral mgrin snying lter thim/ sad/ rmi/ gnyid/ 'pho sbyangs/ dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhir byas/

bla ma snyoms 'jug gis zhu ba rang la bstim mo// gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la gsum/ byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems so// dang po ni mdun du ma bsam/ des bdag la lus srog byin/ blang dor bstan| dka' ba spyad pa rnams kyi drin bsam/ de la byams pa skyes nas sems can thams cad la spel te bsgom mo// gnyis pa snying rje la'ang*/ rten gsal btab/ de la sems can dang*| chos dang*/ dmigs med kyi snying rje bsgom/ skyes nas sems can thams cad la spel te bsgom mo// gsum pa byang chub kyi sems la gnyis/ kun rdzob dang don dam mo// dang po la gnyis/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'o// de'i snga ma ni 'dod pa/ phyi ma ni rtsom pa'o// de gnyis bsdoms te gnas pa'i rgyu bzhi/ dbye ba dpes nyer gnyis/ sas bzhi/ ngo bo gnyis/ blang tshul/ gtong thabs/ bslab bya rnams tshang ba dgos pas/ rgyas par na thugs bskyed chen mo ltar ram/ bsdu na rang gis len pa'i cho ga ltar byas la/ de'i bslab bya rnams brda 'phrod nges bya'o// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ yi dam sgom pa/ bla ma sgrub pa/ phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ smin lam dang grol lam mo// dang po ni/ dbang sta gon dngos gzhi tshang zhing brda don 'phrod par bskur ba shin tu gal che'o// gnyis pa la bcu/ rang lus yi dam du gsal/ srung 'khor bsgom| 'od gsal du 'jug /mngon byang lngas lha rdzogs par bskyed/ dag pa dran/ gnas gsum byin rlabs go cha bgo/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bcing mnyes/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab| mchod bstod/ sngags bzla ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'o// gnyis pa cho ga ltar ro// gsum pa zla ba ā di phrag gnyis mtshan so gnyis me long ye shes/ de'i steng nyi ma kā di phrag gnyis dpe byad mnyam nyid/ de dag gi bar du hūm̐ dang rdo rje sor rtog /de thams cad 'dres pa nan tan/

de las lha rdzogs pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum bskyed pa chos dbyings ye shes te lngas rnam pa gsal bar bskyed/ bzhi pa la dgu/ srung 'khor/ gzhal yas khang*/ lha/ rgyan/ phyag mtshan/ rtsa khams/ nyin mtshan/ ming sogs kyi dag pa dran pa'o// lnga pa la gsum/ yab yum gyi gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyis rgyas btab/ yab la dpa' bo drug dang*/ yum la dpa' mo drug gi go cha bgo'o// drug pa ni cho ga dkyus ltar ro// bdun pa la drug /dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba spyan drangs/ mchod/ gsol ba btab nas/ dbang rgyas pa bdag 'jug ltar ro// bsdu na sgrub thabs ltar bya/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab bo// brgyad pa la lnga/ phyi/ nang*/ gsang ba/ de kho nas mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod do// dgu pa la gnyis/ phreng ba byin gyis brlabs/ bzlas pa sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// gnyis pa bla ma bsgrub pa la bzhi/ sprul/ longs/ chos/ ngo bo nyid do// dang po sprul skur bsgrub pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du seng ge pad zla'i steng*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan pa'i bdag po shāka thub sprul sku mtshan dpe rdzogs shing g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng du lhung bzed rin po ches gang ba bsnams pa 'od 'phro ba bsgom/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs kyis bstod/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ gsol ba drag tu btab/ mthar rang la bstim/ sems ma bcos par bzhag go// gnyis pa longs skur bsgrub pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying chu skyes pad nyi'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma longs sku rnam snang gangs can mtsho rgyan can sku la zhing khams thams cad snang zhing*/ zhing khams thams cad la skus khyab pa/ 'od 'phro ba'i dpral mgrin snying gar/ zla pad nyi mar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar 'phros/ 'gro sgrib sbyangs/ bla mar bsgyur/ 'dus sngags phreng la thim/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar du bsdus nas dmigs med du bzhag go// gsum pa chos skur bsgrub pa ni/

rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ge pad zla nyi steng*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang mtshan dpes brgyan rdzogs 'od 'phro ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum rang rang gi mdog can las 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs la thim pas kun 'dus su gyur/ bdun rnam dag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba btab| mos gus bya/ yi ge gsum las rim gyis 'od 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sgrib pa gsum sbyangs/ dbang gsum thob/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa dag /dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam mo// bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi skur bsgrub pa ni/ rang sems don dam pa'i bla mar shes par byas la/ bdun rnam dag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba btab nas/ sems gdod nas rnam dag phyag rgya chen po/ de nyid 'gag med du shar ba bla mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis ka dbyer med du bsgoms pas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum med pa'i chos longs sprul sku dbyer med ngo bo nyid skur tshang bar rtogs so// gsum pa don gyi snying po phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la gnyis/ khrid rim dang*/ ngo sprod pa'o// dang po la gnyis| zhi gnas khyad par can sgrub pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi sgo nas 'khrid pa'o// dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin skyon med kyis zhi gnas sgrub pa'i sems 'dzin pa la gnyis/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do// dang po la gnyis/ rten can dang rten med do// dang po ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ mdun du dmigs rten ha cang dkar ba ma yin pa la sems gtad nas/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad rbad kyis bcad nas sems rten de nyid la sems ci gnas su bzhag /mtshan mo smin mtshams su thig le dkar po dang res 'ga' lte 'og tu thig le nag po la sems gtad la sngar ltar bsgom/ gnyis pa rten med la gnyis/ rlung can dang rlung med do// dang po rlung can ni/ rlung 'jug gnas gsum la sems gtad/

yang rlung bum can bzung ba la sems gtad la bsgom/ gnyis pa rlung med ni/ tshogs drug gi yul snang la sems mi spro zhing dus gsum gyi 'gyu bar mi 'brang bar bcos lhad dgag sgrub med par ci gnas su bzhag go// gnyis pa mtshan med la gnyis/ sgrim pa dang glod pa'o// dang po ni/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug ngar dang bcas pa la bcos med du bsgom/ de'ang yud tsam nas bshig la slar bsgrims te bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ sems rtog med du zo glod nas rang babs su bzhag nas ci gnas yun sring zhing bsgom/ 'gyu ba phra mo la dgag sgrub mi bya bar ngal gso zhing bskyang ngo// gnyis pa lhag mthong gi shes rab kyis brtags shing dpyad nas gtan la dbab pa shes rab kyi phar phyin bdag med rtogs pa'i thabs la gnyis/ sems snang sna tshogs gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gzhi rtsa la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sems kyi ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa dang*| de'i rtsal rnam rtog dang snang ba'i ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa'o// dang po ni/ sems kyi dbyibs/ gzugs/ kha dog /gnas dang rten/ gnas pa gsal lam/ stong ngam/ de 'dra ba'i rigs la brtags shing dpyad/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam rtog gang skyes pa de la bltas nas/ rnam rtog de'i dbyibs/ gzugs/ kha dog /rten gnas/ byung gnas 'gro gsum sogs la gong ltar brtags shing dpyad nas rang thag bcad pa'i myong ba phra zhib can 'byung ngo// gnyis pa gzhi rtsa la sgro 'dogs gcod pa ni/ rnam rtog sems su thag bcad/ snang ba sems su thag bcad/ sems gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba bcad/ gang shar skye med du thag bcad pa'o// dang po ni/ rnam rtog de gang nas byung*/ sems las byung ngam ma byung*/ sems dang gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na sems las rnam rtog 'ong ba ci/ mi gcig na dbye khyad gang gis 'byed/ mthar gang du song sogs brtags shing dpyad/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs la mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas bltas pas/

yul de dang sems gcig gam tha dad/ tha dad na phan tshun steng 'og lta bu so sor rang tshugs thub pa ltar 'dug gam/ der snang tsam du 'dug blta/ gcig na phan tshun sogs nas gcig gam 'dres nas gcig sogs brtag go// gsum pa ni/ sems gnas pa'i dus brtag /'gyu ba'i dus brtag /gnas nang gi 'gyu ba la brtag /'gyu nang gi gnas pa la brtag pa sogs bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ sems ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i gsal stong de ga'i ngo bo ci 'dra 'dug lta ba'ang gal che ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ngo sprod pa la gnyis/ ngo sprod dngos dang*/ skyon sel ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sems nyid lhan skyes/ rnam rtog lhan skyes/ snang ba lhan skyes so| |dang po ni/ sems rang babs su gnas pa zhi gnas dang*/ de'i ngo bo smrar ma btub la myong rgyu yod pa lhag mthong dang*/ de gnyis ming tha dad la ngo bo gcig pa zhi lhag zung 'brel sems rang babs su bzhag pas rtog pa rang grol ba sems nyid lhan skyes so// gnyis pa rnam rtog gi ngo bo la bltas pas rnam rtog yal ba ma yin pa/ rnam rtog sgom gyi steng du ma bzhag par| rnam rtog de ga ngos bzung med par gsal stong du rtogs pa ni rnam rtog lhan skyes so// gsum pa ni/ tshogs drug gi snang ba gang shar la bltas pas yul yul can gnyis khyad med pa gsal stong la/ de'ang gzugs sogs ma 'gags pa/ gzugs sogs bcos pa'i gsal stong ma yin pa/ snang tsam nas snang ba rang stong*/ rang grol/ snang ba phyir ma lus/ sems nang na ma lus/ snang ba ngan du med/ sems bzang du med pa/ snang ba sogs med bzhin du snang ba/ snang la ngos bzung med pa rjen lhang ba de ni snang ba chos skur shar ba ste snang ba lhan skyes so// gnyis pa/ sgom skyon bshad pa la gnyis/ shor gol gyi skyon ngos bzung ba dang*/ sgom skyon med gshis babs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ shes bya'i gshis la shor ba la chos thams cad gdod nas ma grub par thag bcad rgyu 'bras la skur pa 'debs pa'i ye shor/

sgom gyi ngo bo 'chad shes kyang rang gis ma myong ba'i 'phral shor/ gnyis pa lam du shor ba la'ang sgom lam 'bras dbyer med ma shes par sgom la lam byas nas 'bras bu chos sku thob tu re ba'i ye shor/ sgom skyon med rang la yod bzhin du blos mi khel bar slar gzhan 'tshol zhing sgom la rnam rtog gi lhan pa rgyab pa 'phral shor/ gsum pa gnyen por shor ba la'ang sgom spang gnyen dbyer med ma shes par rang mdangs la rang rig gi gnyen po rgyag pa'i ye shor/ rnam rtog gang skyes rang grol sbrul mdud ltar ma rtogs par rnam rtog bshig nas slar sgom du 'jog pa 'phral shor/ bzhi pa rgyas 'debs su shor ba la'ang sgom thabs shes dbyer med ma shes par dmigs bcas la dmigs med kyis rgyas 'debs pa'i ye shor/ sgom lam du ma lhong bar rnam rtog snga ma de ma nyan bsam phyi bsnyags byas nas sgom gyi rgyas 'debs pa rnam rtog sgom gyis bcad pa'i 'phral shor rnams so// yang gol sa gsum gyi dang po bde bar gol ba ni/ tshor drug bde bar shar ba'i nyams la zhen pas 'dod khams su gol/ gnyis pa gsal ba nyin mtshan dbyer med lkog gyur mthong ba gzhan sems shes pa/ lkog sgra thos pa sogs 'od gsal mngon shes lta bu'i nyams shar ba la zhen pas gzugs khams su gol/ gsum pa mi rtog pa stong gzugs kyi rtags snang mang po 'char ba thams cad stong pa'i 'dzin stangs skye ba sogs stong 'jam la nges shes skyes pa'i nyams la zhen pas gzugs med khams su gol lo// gzhan yang sgom skyon brjod kyis mi lang ba yod pa ni/ kho bo'i rtog med rdo rje'i glur ltos shig /gnyis pa gshis babs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa la'ang gnyis/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngos bzung ba dang*/ nyams len skyong tshul lo// dang po ni/ sems kyi rang babs las gzhan pa'i rnam rtog mi dgag /stong nyid mi sgrub| mi bsam/ mi mno/ mi sgom/

mi spro/ mi dgag /mi blang bar rang sems bzo med rjen lhang smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa/ rang rig dran pas ma yeng ba spang blang dgag sgrub gang yang byar med pa de nyid tha mal gyi shes pa gnyug ma'i don yin no// gnyis pa la bzhi/ skyong tshul/ la bzla ba/ lam 'khyer spyod pa/ rtogs pa skye tshul lo// dang po ni| gang shar gyi ngo bo bzo med du skyong zhing*/ zhen log /mi rtag pa/ mos gus/ dran pa/ snying rje/ khrel ngo tsha rnams sgom gyi yan lag tu bag dang ldan par nyams su blang*/ rtsis gdab med pa/ ngos bzung med pa/ rang babs su bzhag pa ste/ so ma rang thang lhug par zhen med du ma yeng bar bskyang*/ rnam pa kun tu sgom du med cing ma yeng bar rang babs rang gshis gcer yan du zo glod nas bskyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la bzla ba ni/ sgom gsal stong khor yug /nyin snang yeng med kyi rtogs pa la nges shes skyes pa'i tshe/ la dor dgos pas/ thog mar res rtog pa dgag /res spro/ bde sdug sogs rtog pa mang po la blta/ lus rnam 'gyur mang po byas la 'char/ dus gsum gyi sems la blta/ bdag dang gzhan gyi sems la blta ba sogs thabs du ma'i sgo nas brtags shing dpyad nas gtan la 'bebs/ la dor ba dngos ni/ spang blang re dogs thams cad spangs pa'i sems kyi ngo bo gcer mthong de nyid la 'dzin med du bskyang*/ sems dum re yengs kyang skyon du mi blta/ brtag dpyad mi bya/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba nyung du btang*/ za nyal 'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad bcos med zang thal gcer yan gyi ngang nas bya/ mdor na gang shar 'dzin med yeng med du skyong ba ste/ tshul 'dis ni bzang zhen can gyi dge sbyor lo brgya bsgoms pa bas 'di zhag gcig sgom pa phyod che'o// gsum pa lam 'khyer gyi spyod pa la/ dus dang*/ spyod pa/ rnam rtog /nyon mongs/ lha 'dre/ sdug bsngal/ na tsha/ 'chi ba sogs lam du 'khyer tshul so sor bshad kyang don gcig pas gang shar gang byung thams cad bzang la mi re mi sgrub/

ngan la mi dogs mi spong bar/ gang shar bzo med du skyong ba las gzhan gang yang med pa nyid yin no// bzhi pa rtogs pa skye tshul bogs 'don dang bcas pa ni/ gang zag so so'i dbang po'i bye brag gis/ rtse gcig /spros bral/ ro gcig /sgom med de rnal 'byor bzhi| de rnams la'ang chung 'bring chen por dbye bas bcu gnyis sogs gsungs mod/ don du rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus pa bgrod pa'i phyir/ sems kyi ngo bo las gzhan gang du'ang spros pa med do// bogs 'don ni skabs thob kyis shes so// spyi don gsum pa/ rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa la'ang gsum/ zhing*/ bsam pa/ dngos po gsum mo// dang po ni| zhing yar gdam pa gnad zab la/ gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid phyag rgya chen po las ma g.yos bzhin du gzhan phan gyi bsam pa'o// gsum pa ni/ 'dus byas 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba dang*/ 'dus ma byas khams rang bzhin rnam dag bde gshegs snying po bsngo tshul ni 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul gyis bsngo ste/ mdor bsdu na 'khor 'das dus gsum bsags dang sogs sho lo ka'am/ bdag 'khor ma'i khongs su bsdu'o// smras pa/ brjod med don dam rtogs pa'i phyir// rjod byed sbyor dngos rjes bcas par// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan zhes// phag gru 'jig rten mgon por bcas// yab sras bzhed gzhung 'di yin no// dkar po chig thub ces pa'i don// ma go go mdog byas pa'i bsnyad// chig thub gnyis gsum bzhi lnga la// 'gyur zhes ltar snang sdebs legs pa// blun po'i snying mig rna ba sogs// dga' zhing tshim mod don mthong bas| |dpyad tshe de skad smra ba po'i// rang mtshang gsal por shes te ltos// lnga ldan khrid la rgyas dang bsdus// dbang po'i khyad par la ltos nas// gong ma rnams kyis 'ga' mdzad mod| |deng sang de don ma rtogs par// rgyas bsdus re res chog par rlom// de 'dras 'khrid pa'i slob ma rnams// snying rje'i gnas gyur de skyob dang*// rang nyid dran pa gso ba dang*| |nyams len srang du 'jug pa'i phyir// rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di byas so// 'di nyid rtsa bar byas nas kyang*// yan lag go don brda sprod pa// lung rigs myong ba rnam gsum gyis// gtan la phab nas legs bshad na// chos sku don dam rtogs pa la// sgra skad che yang dka' ba min// rang bzo'i 'chal gtam bskal pa'i bar// thos shing bsgoms kyang snying po ci// de bas 'di la 'bad par rigs// 'di dge dkar ba gang yin pa// rgyal rnams mdun du mchod pa dang*// ma rnams rdzogs byang thob phyir bsngo// de ltar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/

deng sang lnga ldan la ming gcig kyang don mi gcig pa du ma zhig snang ba'i mun sprul sel ba dang*/ rang gi dran pa gso ba dang*/ skal ldan dga' la phan pa dang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i bzhed pa mi 'chol ba'i slad du/ skyu ra'i gdung las gnas lugs rang gshis rtogs pa dbur smyon zhes sam/ ming gzhan chos kyi grags pas/ shing khams phag gi lo sa ga zla ba'i dus chen gsum 'dzoms pa dkar cha'i rdzogs pa gsum pa la/ gdan sa chen po dpal 'bri gung du mgyogs par zin bris su bgyis pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
